title: error_invocation uses .expect() in library code; use fallback value instead
description: response.rs:37 calls serde_json::to_value(&err).expect("JmapError::Serialize is infallible"). The invariant is real and well-commented, but .expect() in library code panics the caller's thread on a violation rather than degrading. A clean alternative: .unwrap_or_else(|_| serde_json::json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": "internal error"})) — this preserves infallibility in practice, does not panic, and self-documents the fallback.
